name: mt_bench_101_alpaca_eval
description: mt_bench_101_alpaca_eval is a model evaluation dataset designed to assess conversational and instruction-following quality across many prompts; it aggregates example interactions and evaluations (often pairwise or rated) intended to compare model outputs. The dataset is used to benchmark variants of Alpaca-style instruction-tuned models and similar instruction-following LLMs.
reputation: Used for instruction-following LLM comparisons; moderately cited within community forks/evaluations but not an established de facto standard.
